summary: Lando Norris outmaneuvered Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli through superior pit-stop strategy to secure McLaren's second consecutive victory at Zandvoort. George Russell's sprint win proved merely a prelude as Norris controlled the main race, while Lewis Hamilton's second-place finish was complicated by Ferrari's delayed pit-stop decisions on Charles Leclerc. The victory extends McLaren's championship momentum, though Norris acknowledged afterward that his car lacks the consistency needed to mount a sustained title challenge.
